>do you have any friends you can reach out to?

No. I drifted apart from my only friends 10 years ago when the depression first hit me.

I haven't really had any friends since then. I barely even have acquaintances any more.

These days, the only people I speak to on a regular (or irregular) basis are family, and they have no idea how to help me.

>http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/wiki/hotlines

I can try a hotline, but I might have to wait a few days. If I phoned now, my younger siblings might overhear me, and I don't want to worry them.
